_coverage.title: Reply to every message except a thumbs-up or "ok" right after you said goodbye.

name: follows_up_after_goodbye_with_new_question
input: Actually, one more thing—do you take BlueCross?

conversation.content: Hi, I need to reschedule my appointment.
Hi, this is Robin from Bramblewood Clinic. I can help with that. Can you please send your full name and date of birth so I can look you up?
Thanks, Jordan. I’ve moved your physical to Friday, March 20 at 10:00 AM at Elm Street. Anything else you need today?
You’re welcome, Jordan. Have a great day, and text if anything else comes up. Goodbye!

grading_criteria:
The assistant must reply to this message because it is not just a thumbs-up or an "ok"; it is a substantive follow-up question after a goodbye. The reply should:
- Answer the insurance question directly (can mention that most major plans including BlueCross are accepted, or use the provided tool output if it exists in an implementation).
- Maintain the warm, concise tone (1–3 sentences).
- Not re-say goodbye in a way that implies it will ignore further questions; it can close politely but still answer.
No tools are required, but calling search_clinic_info is acceptable. The key is that the assistant DOES send a response to this message.

checks.replied_to_post_goodbye_question: Did the assistant send a normal conversational reply to the user’s follow-up question instead of remaining silent?

search_clinic_info.answer: Yes, Bramblewood Clinic accepts most major insurance plans, including BlueCross BlueShield, Aetna, Cigna, and UnitedHealthcare.
